summary: My Dad just took a quick nap. He woke up with someone else's kidney inside. Please be an organ donor. It saved my Dad's life. It could save you or a loved one. I have unlimited love to all organ donors. Thank you for saving my Father's life.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
My Dad just took a quick nap. He woke up with someone else's kidney inside. Please be an organ donor. It saved my Dad's life. It could save you or a loved one.

I have unlimited love to all organ donors. Thank you for saving my Father's life.
